text:
**Best overall: Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with a 200W panel, $699** (list $879)

- It has 1,070Wh, 1,500W AC output, a LiFePO4 battery, and about a 1-hour fast charge from a wall outlet.
- It is Amazon's "Overall Pick" for this search, rated 4.5 stars across 1.4K reviews, with 2K+ bought in the past month.
- Talk of the House also made it their editor's choice. They note it weighs 23.8 lbs and the 200W panel recharges it in roughly 6-8 hours of good sun. They also say the app is needed for emergency fast charging, and the panel ships separately.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included). This link goes to the search results page, so look for the Jackery listing.

**Close alternatives at the same price (about $699)**

- **EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic with a 220W panel:** 1,024Wh, 1,800W, 10ms UPS, 4.6 stars (404 reviews). Top Consumer Reviews ranks EcoFlow #1 overall for its app, UPS capability, and expandability. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)
- **BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 with a 200W panel:** 1,024Wh, 1,800W, 0-80% charge in 45 minutes, 4.5 stars (1.8K reviews). [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)

**Budget pick: UDPOWER S1200 with a 120W panel, $549.99**

It has 1,190Wh and 1,200W output, but it has far fewer reviews (41, 4.1 stars). [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

**For home backup**

- **Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with 2×200W panels, $1,399:** 2,042Wh and 2,200W, 4.6 stars. Talk of the House picks it for home backup. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)
- **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 with 2×200W panels, $1,399:** 2,073.6Wh, 2,600W, 4.7 stars. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)
- **Jackery HomePower 3000 with 2×200W panels, $1,799:** 3,072Wh and 3,600W. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

**Notes**

- Prices come from the search listings dated Oct 2026 and change often, so check the final price at checkout.
- I left out the ALLPOWERS P1800 because it is a power station only. It accepts solar input but doesn't include panels.
- Costco also carries a Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 bundle for $899.99, though it was out of stock at the Mountain View warehouse. [Costco](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html)

If you tell me what you'll power (camping, a fridge, CPAP, whole-home backup), I can narrow this to one pick.

Sources: [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels), [Talk of the House](https://www.talkofthehouse.com/best-solar-generator-kits-with-panels/), [Top Consumer Reviews](https://www.topconsumerreviews.com/best-solar-generators/detailed-reviews.php), [Costco](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html)
